name: kb_964_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: SELinuxOptions are the labels to be applied to the container

level.description: Level is SELinux level label that applies to the container.

role.description: Role is a SELinux role label that applies to the container.

type.description: Type is a SELinux type label that applies to the container.

user.description: User is a SELinux user label that applies to the container.

schema.description: SELinuxStrategyOptions defines the strategy type and any options used to create the strategy.

seLinuxOptions.description: seLinuxOptions required to run as; required for MustRunAs More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

description:
The security policy for the upcoming deployment has been set to enforce the **MustRunAs** SELinux rule. This means that each container must run with the specific SELinux context defined below.

The required SELinux options are: user **system_u**, role **object_r**, type **container_t**, and level **s0:c123,c456**. Please ensure that these labels are applied to the pod specifications so that the compliance checks pass successfully.
